recentItems.description:
OSD Bhiksham Reddy Exclusive Interview | Crime Diaries With Muralidhar#740 | iDream#idreamnews 

BIKSHAM REDDY
OSD Cyber Security Bureau Telangana

In Episode #740 of Crime Diaries with Muralidhar, we sit down with Bhiksham Reddy, a 1991-batch police officer currently serving as OSD (Officer on Special Duty) at the Telangana Cyber Security Bureau (TGCSB).

From tackling conventional crimes in Hyderabad's most sensitive areas (Osmania University, Abids, Bahadurpura, and Charminar) to leading the fight against invisible cyber criminals, Bhiksham Reddy shares gripping real-life investigation stories and essential tips to safeguard your hard-earned money from modern online scams.

Key Highlights & Topics Discussed:

1930 Helpline & AI Integration: How TGCSB eliminated call waiting times using reciprocal AI voice bots to freeze stolen funds immediately.

Digital Arrest Scams: Shocking real-life case studies of how victims were trapped overnight and how police intervened just in time to save ₹60 Lakhs and ₹25 Lakhs.

APK Files & WhatsApp Hacks: How fake traffic challan links, electricity bill alerts, and "No" button traps hijack your phone, steal OTPs, and drain bank accounts.

Stock Trading & Investment Frauds: Why nearly 70% of all cyber fraud money is lost in fake Telegram and WhatsApp trading groups.

Old Hyderabad Policing: Handling communal tensions in Bahadurpura, Miralam Eidgah bandobast, airport immigration hurdles, and enforcing COVID-19 lockdowns at Charminar.

The Golden Rule of Cyber Safety: Why "easy money" is always a trap and how staying alert online can protect you from becoming a victim.

recentItems.description:
#advocate #nageshwarrao #nageshwarraopujari  #JournalistVali



Many people take extreme steps due to business losses, financial mismanagement, and unbearable pressure from lenders. The recent tragic incident involving Nageswara Pujari in Guntur is a painful reminder of this crisis. However, suicide is NEVER the solution to debt! The Indian legal system provides clear, legitimate pathways to protect borrowers and resolve financial crises peacefully.

In this video, you will learn:
00:00 - The Guntur Incident & The Reality of Debt Traps in Society
01:45 - How High-Interest Hand Loans Lead to Financial Mismanagement
03:10 - Option 1: How to Get Legal Time Extension (Injunction) from Court to Repay Debts
04:15 - Option 2: What is an Insolvency Petition (IP)? How to File IP When You Have Zero Assets
06:00 - Do You Still Have to Pay After Filing IP? How Court Inquiry Works
08:30 - Why Consulting a Good Advocate Can Save Your Life & Family

If you or someone you know is drowning in debt or facing harassment from lenders, please do not take any hasty decisions. Consult a qualified advocate and handle the situation legally. Your life is far more valuable than any amount of money.

⚠️ Disclaimer: This video is strictly for legal awareness and educational purposes only. Please consult a qualified lawyer for advice tailored to your specific legal situation.

In this video, we break down the sensational investigative report by The Indian Express regarding the Adani Group's Tarali Pumped Storage Project in Maharashtra.

How did a ₹5,675 Crore project cost get reduced by 99% to ₹56.75 Crore in official letters to slash mandatory wildlife and environmental compensation from ₹227 Crore to ₹2.27 Crore? Alongside this corporate controversy, we examine the stark contrast in the Indian economy—where middle-class families are struggling to repay gold loans, leading to massive 6-page newspaper advertisements for gold auctions.

Key Topics Covered:

Full analysis of the Tarali Pumped Storage Project controversy.

How a forest official's complaint exposed the 99% cost drop.

Corporate accountability and the reality of GDP growth for the common man.

The hidden financial crisis of the Indian middle class.
